name: Brazil
summary: South American continent-spanning nation hosting the greater Amazon Basin. Boasts one of the world's cleanest national electricity grids dominated by hydroelectric, bioenergy, and wind generation, while managing agricultural frontier deforestation pressure.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.56x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); seasonal agricultural burning causes intense regional smoke spikes in the Legal Amazon.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; set all-time national record high average annual temperature in 2023.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate over 1994-2023; heightened temperature variance across Pantanal and Cerrado biomes.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.3% share of global fossil emissions; excludes land-use change emissions where deforestation remains critical.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Significantly below world average of 4.7 t CO2/person due to hydro-dominant national grid.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~4,960,000 km² of tropical rainforest, Cerrado savanna, and Atlantic coastal forest biomes.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Global clean power leader: hydropower (60.4%), wind (13.2%), bioenergy (8.2%), and solar (7.4%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 26 people/km²; urban population fraction is 87.8%.
